title: Grusch's terms came from crash retrieval program briefings

tellings.quote: yeah I think he's heard that from his briefings given to from the briefings given to him on the crash retrieval program

plain: Words David Grusch uses, a former Air Force intelligence officer who says the US has recovered non-human craft, came from briefings he was given on a crash retrieval programme, a secret effort said to recover and hold crashed craft. Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon studies of unexplained aerial reports, tells Michels he thinks this is where Grusch heard them. If so, it would mean Grusch was briefed on such a programme from the inside.
